QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Fire
QuestInfo.0: Go see #bChief Knight Oz#k in Ereve and raise the Skill Level of Oz's Flame Gear.
QuestInfo.1: To use Oz's Flame Gear, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Fire. You can get it from #r#o4230503##k or #r#o3110300##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've raised the Skill Level of Oz's Flame Gear skill. Until Lv. 90, use Burning Flare every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1.

0.0: Hi, I'm Chief Knight Oz. You must be #b#h0##k. I heard the Empress sent you. Did you come here to learn Flame Gear? If you love peace as much as I do, I can help.

yes.0: If you wish, I'll teach you my Flame Gear skill. However, you'll need the power of the Spirit of Fire. For such powerful force, you will need Burning Flares.
yes.1: If you can bring #b10 #t4032868#s#k from #r#o4230503#s#k or #r#o3110300#s#k, I'll teach you Flame Gear.

no.0: If not, you may leave Ereve. The sooner, the better!

1.0: Was that difficult? It's not easy obtaining Burning Flares.

yes.0:
The Skill Level of Flame Gear has increased by 1.
And don't forget that you can come every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1 until Lv. 90.

item.0: You need #b10 #t4032869#s#k, which can be obtained from #r#o4230503#s#k or #r#o3110300#s#k, to raise the Skill Level of Flame Gear.
